contentPageAbout.title: About Me
contentPageAbout.textAbout1: Frontend developer with over 1 year of experience in creating modern web applications and interfaces. I am able to run a full cycle of client development, from adaptive layout to backend integration and performance optimization. I am confident in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js and modern development tools.
contentPageAbout.textAbout2: I am distinguished by my attention to detail, I understand the principles of UX/UI well, and I am able to turn ideas into user-friendly, scalable, and aesthetic interfaces. I work effectively both independently and in distributed teams, adhering to the best practices in code, testing and version control. I strive for continuous development and creation of solutions that bring real value to users.
skills: Frontend development: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+)
State management: React Hooks, Context API
Integration with REST APIs & backend services
Performance optimisation (lazy loading, code splitting, caching)
Modern styling: Tailwind CSS, SCSS, Ant Design, Material UI
UX/UI principles: clean layouts, accessibility, user-focused design
Animation & interactivity: Framer Motion, GSAP, CSS transitions

contentPageEducation.certCiscoTop: IT Essentials: PC Hardware and Software · Cisco Networking Academy
contentPageEducation.text: I began my front-end development journey as a self-taught developer, learning web technologies from courses, tutorials, and documentation. Over time, I mastered HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React. I gained most of my skills through hands-on experience—creating projects, solving real-world problems, and constantly learning new tools to stay up-to-date with the industry.

contentPageProject.title: Project
contentPageProject.textKinotower: KinoTower is a web app about movies where you can view descriptions and posters, search for the movie you need, and easily find information about the movie in one place.
contentPageProject.textSoundbloom: SoundBloom is a modern web app built with React and a minimalist approach that lets you listen to tracks directly in your browser, create a listening environment, and then add your own compositions.
